question: Which exact .177 UI refresh, visibility, draw-buffer and GPU/cache contracts permit event-driven native backgrounds without late object callbacks or timer-driven snapshots?
prototype_hypothesis: Exact AAPCS contracts from native consumers and Thumb disassembly; see each restricted symbol. ROM invalidation body is not in AP.
callsite_evidence: 0x0c3894d0 dispatches display REFR_START=52 before layout/invalid-area join and object drawing; REFR_READY=53 occurs after invalid-area cleanup. 0x0c384528 sends DELETE=36 before event storage free.
0x0c381eae dispatches display+736 event list in PREPROCESS then ordinary pass; 0x0c3a3e08 tests filter bit 0x8000 and low-15-bit event matching.
0x0c386c14 stores aligned data at +16 and raw allocation at +20. 0x0c386904 uses +16; 0x0c3868bc frees +20.
0x0c3998a4 calls vg_lite_finish at 0x0c91e58c and treats zero as success. 0x0c91da14 waits via native kernel command 5.

0x0c9252c0 passes cache ID 1/start/length to ROM thunk 0x0c721248. hal_cache_sync 0x0c92e5f4 writes D-cache sync register +0x34. _lv_inv_area 0x0c382080 takes a DISPLAY, unlike object wrapper 0x0c382198.
control_flow_evidence: Resource-hook static tests pin complete function byte spans and the exact AP SHA256.
ARM-guarded host mocks exercise 39 frame/lifecycle/failure cases with distinct aligned/raw data and explicit fence/cache/publication ordering. These are not physical GPU or ROM validation.
A read-only independent source reviewer identified lifecycle/deferred-wake issues; implementation corrections and dedicated host regressions followed.

2026-10-06: the user reported successful hardware validation of the current background implementation and requested a commit. No detailed procedure, captured GPU trace or fault/performance measurements were supplied; this is feature-level user-reported acceptance, not independent per-symbol DEVICE_PROVEN evidence.
ownership_analysis: One module callback per validated live display, removed for all-system mode. DELETE clears saved subscription before native destruction. Epoch checks prevent stale frame writes. Shared blur buffer remains resident for module lifetime; failed post-snapshot fence pins the pool snapshot until successful independent retirement. Reboot-required stop semantics are unchanged.
unsafe_assumptions: Functional device acceptance is user-reported; independent GPU/coherence/fault probes, frame timing and public callable approval remain unverified.
ROM cache invalidation implementation is outside AP; only caller ABI is statically recovered.
No framework restart, forced unload, arbitrary concurrent UI mutations or GPU recovery safety is claimed.
Host registration-failure mocks do not prove native event-list allocator OOM behavior.
BES OpenPineBuds HAL source corroborates cache API/register conventions, not exact BEST1503 hardware behavior.
recommended_probe: On exact .177 record cold blur display, cached close/reopen and watchface changes, all-system restoration and repeated reload callback counts. Measure latency/memory, inspect GPU timeout/coherence separately. Do not force-unload a resident module.
